title: COS natural-fiber picks — verified on cos.com
summary: Live-crawled COS.com product pages on 2026-10-19. 6 items shown with verified gallery images. 7 screenshot items excluded because COS.com confirmed synthetic or undisclosed-plant blends in their shell (hoodie, double-faced wool-blend, alpaca-blend, boiled wool shawl cardigan, zip-up cotton overshirt, relaxed twill shirt, tailored wool coat). Composition for every card pulled from live COS product records; prices reflect live US catalog at capture time.

recommendation.headline: Natural-fiber COS pieces verified against COS.com product composition
recommendation.summary:
The 6 cards below have gallery images captured live from COS.com on 2026-10-19 along with verified composition. 12 additional items passed composition verification but their gallery images could not be fetched this run because the US storefront rate-limited the verification sweep (Akamai). Their product pages resolve live and carry the official imagery:

• Brushed pure cashmere v-neck cardigan (Cashmere 100%) — https://www.cos.com/en-us/men/menswear/knitwear/cardigans/product/brushed-cashmere-v-neck-cardigan-mocha-1357457001
• Pure cashmere crew-neck sweater (Cashmere 100%) — https://www.cos.com/en_us/1288193001.html
• Single-breasted linen blazer (Linen 100% shell) — https://www.cos.com/en-us/men/menswear/suits/blazers/product/single-breasted-linen-blazer-navy-1275809004
• Unstructured linen blazer (Linen 100% shell) — https://www.cos.com/en-ie/men/menswear/suits/blazers/product/unstructured-linen-blazer-dark-khaki-1340011001
• Slim merino wool henley top (Wool 100%) — https://www.cos.com/en_us/1334779003.html
• Slim merino wool crew-neck sweater (Wool 100%) — https://www.cos.com/en_us/1260173002.html
• Merino wool v-neck cardigan (Wool 100%) — https://www.cos.com/en_us/1263815002.html
• Boiled-wool uniform jacket (Wool 100%, closest verified match to boiled wool shawl jacket) — https://www.cos.com/en_us/1351848004.html
• Raw selvedge denim jacket (Cotton 100%) — https://www.cos.com/en_us/1340979001.html
• Relaxed pima cotton poplin shirt (Cotton 100%) — https://www.cos.com/en-us/men/menswear/shirts/cottonshirts/product/relaxed-pima-cotton-poplin-shirt-khaki-1289730024
• Cotton oxford shirt (Cotton 100%) — https://www.cos.com/en-ww/men/menswear/shirts/cottonshirts/product/cotton-oxford-shirt-white-1307720014
• Corded suede overshirt (Goat leather 100%) — https://www.cos.com/en-us/men/menswear/shirts/overshirts/product/corded-suede-overshirt-khaki-1354287002
